accept_rule: candidate_score_pp <=5 and all reference/warmup offers successful; abstain on failures
assumptions: location-shift forecast requires stable response shape and persistence from warmup into measurement; warmup neither bounds future shift nor certifies future reliability
candidate: deadline-amplified median location shift with chronological warmup check
cost_contract: all sample-dependent candidates/comparators get same reference and last25 warmup samples, same decision time; report full apparatus warmup and calibration separately; no claim of qualified 25-offer-only deployment
decision_time: after completed target-rate warmup and drain, before measurement; later than original campaign forecast
inference: campaigns and cohorts dependent, no pooled significance, thresholds frozen for this screen after earlier outcomes known
population: all 18 Go,18 original NGINX,24 policy confirmation and12 rate cohorts; retain saturation and separately report observed10%-90% transition cases
reference: Go complete response pool; original NGINX pool; policy-matched power pool; ordinary fixed-5/s rate pool
role: known-outcome retrospective development; no independent confirmation
shape_diagnostics: ECDF distance after estimated translation and q25/q75 displacement relative to median displacement; descriptive only, no tuned shape cutoff
stopping_rule: no threshold/window/deadline tuning or new performance collection in this assessment; require independent episodes and comparator advantage before proposing confirmation
temporal_rule_ablation: shift-only and chronological-only checks reported without selecting a winner
